summary: At Revantusk Village, Otho Moji'ko sends another message to the Wildhammer. He sees their bond with gryphons as close as a troll and a mate, and means to turn it against them.

sections.title: A Message of Feathers
sections.body: After the Highvale high elves, Otho Moji'ko has another message for the Wildhammer. Their closeness with gryphons disgusts him, but he sees a use for it. Kill the gryphons you meet across the Hinterlands and gather their Long Elegant Feathers. Gryphons live in every region there. Otho will make his final message from the feathers.

sections.title: Otho's Pleasure
sections.body: Otho expects his final message to frighten the Wildhammer away or make them furious. He delights that only one step remains before they learn trolls cannot be crossed.

aliases: who gives another message to the wildhammer
faq.answer: Otho Moji'ko gives the message from Revantusk Village.

faq.q: Why does Otho Moji'ko want gryphon feathers?
faq.answer: Otho says the Wildhammer and their gryphons are as close as a troll and a mate. He means to use that bond against them, and make his final message from the feathers.
Gryphons live in every region of the Hinterlands.

aliases: what comes before another message to the wildhammer
faq.answer: This follows Message to the Wildhammer, in which Otho had Highvale high elves slaughtered as a warning to the dwarves.
